mechanism: Both drugs cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities; ganciclovir increases renal dysfunction risk while chlorthalidone causes volume depletion and electrolyte imbalances that are exacerbated by renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and electrolytes closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antivirals if renal function declines; adjust chlorthalidone dosing if eGFR decreases.
